btc.pool_totals_shape: newline-separated JSON, not one document; Users and Workers include idle and disconnected records
btc.hashrate: wallet hashrate1hr and each worker hashrate1hr; suffixes are none or one of K M G T P E, 1000-based; no KH/MH guess
btc.earnings: no balance, paid, or daily reward fields; they stay null and are not shown as 0
btc.worker_status: inferred only: last share within 10 minutes is online, older is offline, missing, zero, or future is unknown; a stale cached response clears online
btc.partial: reported workers can exceed the returned array; the count is kept and partial is true; idle rows are kept when the reported count is lower

ethw.payment_source: https://ethw.2miners.com/js/account.js getPaymentsMultiplier case DH returns 1e-9; pool config type is DH and isSolo is false
ethw.block_reward_multiplier: getRewardsMultiplier case DH returns 1e-18 and is not applied to balance, paid, or 24hreward
ethw.worker_ranges: OpenAPI enum is only 5m, 30m, and 6h; no 24h worker history endpoint
ethw.paid: missing paid stays null; an explicit 24hreward of 0 stays 0

limitations: The 10-minute online state is a labeled inference. CKPool has no online field.
SQL accepts BTC shape and length, including uppercase bech32 which it stores lowercase. The checksum gate is validBtcAddress before the RPC.
Migration 20261023190000_btc_ethw_pools.sql must be applied before any future production release. It was not applied.
Local PGlite is not production persistence.
CKPool worker lists can be partial. Wallet hashrate is not the sum of returned workers, and the worker count is not a count of physical machines.
Pool-wide Users and Workers are not a wallet result.

Demonstration previews use labeled synthetic data; actual upstream reads were separately verified with pool-published public demonstration addresses. No live-user database writes or production migration were performed.
